note: Family-run park with RV storage on US 54 at the west edge of Iola (1327 US-54), two blocks from a Prairie Spirit Rail Trail trailhead: long pull-through and back-in sites with full hookups and 30/50-amp service, restrooms, showers and a small laundry; nightly, weekly and monthly stays, online booking. Many sites hold full-time workers, with several open for travelers. $40 a night plus a non-refundable reservation fee; tents $15. --Claude
